trim_effect.trimeffectively.sentry.name: Long Shot
trim_effect.trimeffectively.sentry.desc: The farther the foe, the harder the fall; The string follows the eye, and the steel answers all.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.vex.name: Vexing Guard
trim_effect.trimeffectively.vex.desc: Blood on the mail, and the dead take wing; Old spite wakes, and the shadows sing.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.wild.name: Farm Bot
trim_effect.trimeffectively.wild.desc: Moss on the altar, and dust on the door; What the hand takes, the hoard gives once more.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.coast.name: Waterborne
trim_effect.trimeffectively.coast.desc: Drowned ship's breath, and the deep green hall; He walks the wave-light, and he breathes through all.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.dune.name: Prescience
trim_effect.trimeffectively.dune.desc: Spice on the wind, and the stroke unseen; The gap closes, and the blade comes keen.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.wayfinder.de: Old charts are cut in the breastplate's hold; The heart turns homeward, and the seas grow cold.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.raiser.name: Scientific Breeding
trim_effect.trimeffectively.raiser.desc: The herd knows its season, the pen knows its spring; The beasts are bountiful, and the folds all sing.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.shaper.name: Excelsior
trim_effect.trimeffectively.shaper.desc: Old scars are mended, the hammer is worn; The strokes leave no debt, and the steel is reborn.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.host.name: Service Contract
trim_effect.trimeffectively.host.desc: Contract in the breastplate, a mark on the mail; The merchant remembers, the ledger grows pale.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.ward.name: Sculker
trim_effect.trimeffectively.ward.desc: Eyeless deep, the mail hears; sound names the dark, and the blade becomes the Warden's cry.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.silence.name: Low-Key
trim_effect.trimeffectively.silence.desc: Quiet mail, muffled step, and the sound slips away; The breath of the silence is here to stay.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.tide.name: Asperges
trim_effect.trimeffectively.tide.desc: Sea-breath in the mail, and the foul thought flees; One tide washes clean, and the old ill sees ease.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.snout.name: Mammonism
trim_effect.trimeffectively.snout.desc: Gold in the purse, and the edge grows keen; The heavier the hoard, the harder the scene.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.rib.name: Last Stand
trim_effect.trimeffectively.rib.desc: Pain is fuel, and dread is fire; The deeper the wound, the fiercer the ire.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.eye.name: Ender Avatar
trim_effect.trimeffectively.eye.desc: The eye beholds the end of all; The world cracks open, and the shadows fall.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.spire.name: Kinetic Barrier
trim_effect.trimeffectively.spire.desc: Tower-shadows ride the wind's long flight; Where speed goes, the stroke goes wide and light.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.bolt.name: Steadfast
trim_effect.trimeffectively.bolt.desc: Rivets bite the bone, the mail is a hill; Wind and thunder push, but the feet are still.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.flow.name: Sky Leap
trim_effect.trimeffectively.flow.desc: Whirlwind in the mail, and the foot spins free; One fall is done, and another wind we see.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.amethyst.des: Crystal rings true, and the feet grow divine; At death's door, the body is no longer thine.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.copper.name: Tough Shell
trim_effect.trimeffectively.copper.desc: Copper scales clasp soft into tough; Rain strikes the mail, and the sound is enough.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.diamond.name: Forever
trim_effect.trimeffectively.diamond.desc: Diamond in the bone, and the years cannot bite; Old scars stay shallow, and the edge stays bright.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.emerald.name: Millionaire
trim_effect.trimeffectively.emerald.desc: Emerald at the breast, and the merchant marks the wearer; The bargain bends, and the price grows fairer.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.gold.name: Glittering
trim_effect.trimeffectively.gold.desc: Gold gleams on the mail, and the piglins prize the light; The brute calls you kin, and the dark is bright.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.iron.name: Ironclad
trim_effect.trimeffectively.iron.desc: Iron tempered in fire, the mail grows heavy; The spear-point dulls, and the shield is steady.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.lapis.name: Blessed
trim_effect.trimeffectively.lapis.desc: Lapis opens the hidden way, and heaven leans a little; Every choice keeps a thread, and the luck is not brittle.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.quartz.name: Splinter
trim_effect.trimeffectively.quartz.desc: Quartz keeps a hidden edge, and the striker feels the bite; Touch the mail, and the wound returns to smite.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.netherite.de: Alloy quenched in fire, and the flame cannot eat; The burn leaves no mark, and the mail is complete.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.redstone.des: Redstone in the veins, and the hand moves first; The thought is still young, and the stone is burst.
trim_effect.trimeffectively.resin.name: Experienced
trim_effect.trimeffectively.resin.desc: Resin seals the years, and the old deeds take form; All that is lived is gained, and the memory is warm.
